item.title: Banks in Gulf Evacuate Their Offices
item.summary: After an overnight attack on a bank, Iranian officials signaled a new willingness to target economic centers and banks with ties to the United States.

item.title: Lebanese residents are left in shock and fear as Israeli strikes reach the center of Beirut.
Iran holds a public mourning ceremony for commanders killed by strikes.
item.summary: Thousands of people mourned in a state-sanctioned ceremony, as people in Tehran described deepening anxiety and fear as the war continued.

item.title: Iran’s Retaliatory Strikes Appear to Be Slowing
item.summary: U.S. officials say the country’s weapons have been diminished, slowing its attacks on Gulf nations and Israel. Iran may also be holding some weapons in reserve in case the conflict is prolonged.

item.title: Iran Has Fired Widely Banned Cluster Munitions at Israel
item.summary: Accounts from Israeli officials and footage verified by The New York Times show that Iran has targeted Israel with the weapons. Experts say this has exposed civilians to indiscriminate attacks.

item.title: See where U.S. installations have been damaged in the war with Iran.
U.S. at Fault in Strike on School in Iran, Preliminary Inquiry Says
item.summary: Outdated targeting data may have resulted in a mistaken missile strike, according to the ongoing military investigation, which undercuts President Trump’s assertion that Iran could be to blame.

item.title: Democrats Demand Accountability from Hegseth on Iranian School Strike
item.summary: A majority of Senate Democrats called on Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to disclose whether the U.S. carried out the deadly attack.

item.title: World Heritage Sites Hit in Airstrikes on Iran
item.summary: Revered cultural icons that have withstood the upheavals of history are being hit hard in the war being waged by Israel and the United States.

item.title: Iran’s New Supreme Leader Was Wounded Early in the War, Iranian and Israeli Officials Say
item.summary: Officials say Mojtaba Khamenei’s legs were hurt, but the circumstances as well as the extent of his injuries were unclear. He has remained out of view since being announced as leader three days ago.
